## 2026-06-15 - Adding Native Tooltips to Icon-Only Buttons
**Learning:** While `aria-label` successfully provides context to screen readers, sighted users navigating via mouse benefit immensely from native tooltips generated by the standard HTML `title` attribute, especially for ubiquitous components like modals.
**Action:** Add `title` attributes matching the `aria-label` for bare icon-only buttons to ensure full visual and assistive accessibility coverage.
